name: Upstox NSE FnO Stock Underlying Data Foundation
lawful_access_basis: Proposed private local research through the operator-owned account and read-only Analytics Token; no display, redistribution, alerts, orders or trading. Not active until Aditya Lakhotia approves the exact collection and source manifests.
fields: current NSE FnO stock-underlying and option-contract reference metadata
NSE_EQ daily, 15-minute and 5-minute OHLCV with provider bar timestamps
current NSE_EQ quote price, volume, provider timestamp and last-trade timestamp where supplied
local UTC request and receipt timestamps, collection order, content hashes and quality/failure records
latency: Historical requests are downloaded on approval; proposed ongoing underlying quotes every five minutes during the NSE equity session. Quote snapshots are not tick history or guaranteed executable prices.
collection_method: Proposed GET-only NSE instrument master, Upstox V3 historical/intraday candle, and V3 full-market-quote endpoints for NSE_EQ keys only, with no order/account routes.
retention_policy: Proposed private local content-addressed gzip raw storage for seven days, permanent compressed normalized data and audit summaries, with a fail-closed 250 MiB total storage cap and audited raw deletion.
